title: The furnace is at temperature: do heavy steel structures still need load-temperature measurements?
summary: Zoned gas heating for heavy steel structures must be coordinated with loading, support passages and workpiece-temperature sensors. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s proposal dated 12 March 2025 specifies sixteen burner sets, sixteen control zones and sixteen furnace-temperature monitoring points, plus sixteen movable workpiece-temperature points. Furnace sensors observe heating regions; load sensors represent selected workpiece locations. They require separate layouts, and the furnace reaching setpoint does not establish that the workpiece interior has reached temperature.
